intro: Numbered practices, not dates. Rule 14.02 puts the first practice no earlier than July 15, and after that the calendar is yours — a rained-out session moves everything down one, it does not skip anything. The schedule is built out a practice at a time; everything not on it yet is listed at the bottom. Nothing is installed before the thing it depends on, and the build refuses to publish a schedule that breaks that.

preseason.label: Before the first game
preseason.note: Start with the base run both directions and the front we line up in most downs. Do not add anything until these are real — alignment and one play they can run without thinking are worth more in September than six plays they half know.

season.label: Once the season starts
season.note: One new look at a time, and only when the last one has hurt somebody. Each of these exists because a defence has started cheating something — none of it is worth installing before that happens.

practices.focus: Stance, snap, and the first run
practices.emphasis: Alignment before anything. Count seven on the line every single snap, both sides of the ball, until it is boring.
The tailback reads the fullback's block. That is the skill this whole formation exists to teach — give it the time.
